name: vehicle-state
description: Micom CAN vehicle-state model: lab-defined fixed-frame decode (speed/gear/ignition/battery/doors/climate/outside) plus captured CANService Gen3High/Gen2 parser layouts (0x1ab speed/gear, 0x2fc battery, 0x2b0 steering, Gen2 0x56e/0x55a), clamps, range guards, bulk retention and reset; not a vendor DBC and not stock vehicle fidelity.
